description:
[ Spotlight Bible Verse Wallpaper ]
Interactive Bible verse live wallpaper with configurable backgrounds and Bible.com translation references.

[ System Requirements ]
1. Software Requirements
Operating System: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
Required Software: Wallpaper Engine (Steam) or Lively Wallpaper
Technology: HTML5-based interactive wallpaper
Additional Software: No Python installation, standalone local server, or manual PowerShell script execution required
Administrator Privileges: Not required for normal operation
Windows 11 is recommended.

2. Hardware Requirements
Recommended Specifications
CPU: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 equivalent or better
RAM: 8 GB or more
GPU: Integrated graphics supporting DirectX 10/11 or equivalent dedicated graphics
Storage: Approximately 50 MB or more for the wallpaper, plus additional space for downloaded Bible translations
Recommended Display Resolution: 1920 × 1080 (Full HD) or higher
A dedicated graphics card is not required. However, systems with more memory and graphics performance are recommended for 2K/4K displays, multiple monitors, and multitasking.

3. Supported Display Resolutions
The wallpaper supports the following background image resolutions:
Full HD: 1920 × 1080
QHD: 2560 × 1440
4K UHD: 3840 × 2160
Actual image quality and loading performance may vary depending on network conditions, display resolution, and system performance.

4. Internet Connectivity
Online Bible Translations
An internet connection is required to retrieve online Bible translations and passages from Bible.com.
Bible translations can be downloaded through the wallpaper interface for offline reading.
Offline Bible Translations
Built-in Bible translations are available without an internet connection.
Previously downloaded Bible translations can also be accessed offline.
Background images may require an internet connection because they are retrieved from external image services.

5. Offline Data Storage and Compatibility
Built-in Bible translations are included in the wallpaper package.
Downloaded translations are stored in the browser's IndexedDB storage.
Downloaded translations are stored separately in each wallpaper environment and are not automatically shared between Wallpaper Engine and Lively Wallpaper.
Existing JSON Bible translation files can be imported through the offline translation management interface.

6. Local Services and Startup Requirements
No localhost server required
No separate Python runtime required
No manual PowerShell or BAT script execution required
No Windows startup task registration required
Bible translation downloads and storage are managed directly through the wallpaper interface

7. Summary
A lightweight, HTML5-based Bible verse live wallpaper that supports built-in and downloadable offline Bible translations without requiring a separate local server or manual script execution.
Note: Offline access applies to Bible translations and passages. Background images and online Bible content may still require an internet connection.
title: Spotlight Bible Verse Wallpaper
